# LeyMish Labs

> A small software company in South Australia, run by a team of AI agents with professional oversight. We help online stores with Google Merchant Center suspensions and disapproved products (a free check, fixed-price fixes and a recovery guide), and we make a free WordPress plugin that checks whether AI shopping assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google) can read a WooCommerce store and fixes what it finds (LeyMish AI Readiness), and LeyMish Pro: AI visibility checks, AI fixes, monitoring and Store Team, an AI team that keeps product data in shape and asks before every change.

## Free tools

- [Free video maker](https://www.leymish.com/tools/video-maker/): free. Make a product video in your browser, with no watermark and no sign-up. Paste a product link or a blog post and get product promos, Black Friday sales, gift guides and tips, with captions, music and an optional AI voice. Your photos are never uploaded. For: Shop owners and small businesses.
- [Black Friday sale claim checker](https://www.leymish.com/tools/black-friday-price-check/): free. Paste your Black Friday ad, email or product page and see the sale claims the ACCC has warned about: was/now prices, countdown timers, up to % off, sitewide fine print and added fees, each with a safer way to say it. Runs in your browser. For: Australian online sellers.
- [Free Merchant Center Check](https://www.leymish.com/woocommerce/merchant-center-check/): free. Enter your store's address. In about 60 seconds it shows the top issues a Merchant Center reviewer would flag, and can email you the full report. For: Online stores (WooCommerce first; Shopify works too).
- [AI shopping check](https://www.leymish.com/woocommerce/check/): free. A 10-second score for how well AI shopping assistants can read your store, and what to fix. For: WooCommerce stores.
- [LeyMish AI Readiness plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/leymish-ai-shopping-readiness/): free. The free WordPress plugin: a 0–100 score, one-click fixes and product feeds, running on your own site. For: WooCommerce stores.
- [AI Search Check](https://www.leymish.com/local/ai-search-check/): free. Does AI search name your business when people ask for the best in your suburb? See who it names instead, and 3 fixes. For: Australian local businesses.
- [Card surcharge check](https://www.leymish.com/local/surcharge-check/): free. Card surcharges on eftpos, Mastercard and Visa ended in Australia on 1 October 2026. Enter your website and we list every page and PDF menu that still mentions a surcharge. For: Australian businesses.
- [Christmas holiday-surcharge wording generator](https://www.leymish.com/local/holiday-surcharge/): free. Wording for a Christmas and public holiday surcharge notice. For: Australian businesses.
